reference_A_mechanical.description: Economy lower bound: the index anchor is set once and never lifts; only the upper-voice finger moves. Zero shifts; root still; fingertip travel is the upper voice alone.

reference_B_human.description: Acceptance REGION for a held-anchor figure: the index stays planted on string 5 fret 5 for all three moments while the upper voice moves; the anchor never releases.

constraints.unused_fingers: compact; the anchor finger stays down throughout
